conflictStrategy: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, followed by a new SELECT statement
request: JSON object with string keys, finite numbers, and no null text characters
requestDigest: SHA-256 of sorted compact UTF-8 JSON
handler: trusted local writes through the supplied connection; no commit or external call
unfinishedCommit: refused by a deferred constraint trigger
completedMutation: refused by a row trigger and delete grants
retention: No automatic expiry. Review the full retry and reconciliation horizon before a separate archival design.
timeout: Retry a transient wait or connection error with the same operation, key, and request. Resolve committed outcomes before a new logical command.
externalEffect: Retain an unresolved external intent and original provider identity. Provider execution and reconciliation are separate work.
